statement: The operation_workflow_owner's registered operation-ledger self-move cannot be overtaken indefinitely by newer dependent priority ADDs and can never coexist with a second ledger self-move: (1) once the registered self-move's target holds a current READY lease on the dimension the dispatch path itself evaluates (independent of the target's controlPlaneRecoveryEligible/PRIORITY_CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY_PENDING state), the hold is ENGAGED for admission — dependents planned after that point are refused operation_ledger_self_move_in_flight while already-admitted incumbents drain, and the self-move claims as soon as the ledger is idle; (2) the held self-move is released only on a positive authoritative terminal row — never from an orphan-reservation release, a null point read, or a failed read — so exactly one ledger self-move is non-terminal at any time; (3) a failed cluster-wide IDLE census re-reads on the dispatch-retry cadence instead of the incomplete-read backoff. IDLE_ONLY, the exclusion once live, quorum_concentrated deferral, maxConcurrentAdds, CRITICAL_CHECK_DELAY_MS, DISPATCH_RETRY_DELAY_MS, the 60-second GCP certification window and the single cluster-ACTIVE authority are unchanged. Proven by the real-owner witness dependents-stream-after-registration (REPLACE registered at t+0; five ADDs at t+3.5 with cpp learner acked at +30; target READY lease at +14 while still recovery-pending; cpp re-planned at +30.5 and +61; one census read throws at +42; orphan-reservation release plus null point read at +41): red on HEAD (self-move claims at or after +61, a second REPLACE admitted, READY beyond 60s), green after (self-move SENDING by +32, later dependents refused, exactly one non-terminal ledger self-move, READY inside 60s). Root cause from the 4bc6c1d25 streak (runs 23-51-32 and 23-58-17: spread 66s/83s; run 23-51-32 admitted a duplicate self-move 8ae2b559 while b0b98821 was durably PENDING).

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The operation_workflow_owner (RebalanceCoordinator + OperationWorkflowOwner; operation-ledger-hold-policy.js, rebalance-coordinator-ledger-interlock-hold-state.js, rebalance-coordinator-ledger-interlock-admission.js, operation-workflow-dispatch-ledger-self-move-gate.js) stays the sole owner of hold registration/engagement/release, IDLE_ONLY, claim and dispatch; planners, reservation reconciliation, readiness owners and the harness observe and never re-derive or release the hold.

The held ledger self-move is released only by a positive authoritative terminal row; orphan-reservation reconciliation, null point reads, failed reads, and timeouts never release it and never admit a second ledger self-move. Two ledger self-moves must never be non-terminal at once.

IDLE_ONLY (self-move admits only into an idle ledger), exclusion of dependents once the hold is engaged until the terminal, and the quorum_concentrated deferral are byte-for-byte preserved; dt6-rebalancer-formation-self-move-interlock, dt6-formation-ledger-* and the hold-engagement/cadence witnesses stay green.

maxConcurrentAdds, CRITICAL_CHECK_DELAY_MS, DISPATCH_RETRY_DELAY_MS, the incomplete-read backoff bounds, the 60-second GCP certification window and its owner-progress extension, and the failed-repair backoff are unchanged. No sleeps, timeout widening, retry widening, or readiness weakening.

Prove through the real-owner witness (real coordinators/owner/interlock/startup authority, virtual clock, run-cited latencies) red on HEAD and green after, before any GCP run; the GCP streak is certification, never an iteration loop.
Do not make the harness, analyzer, or readiness owner derive cluster-ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage.
